title: SubLLM S1-S7 integration and final artifact qualification

exclusions: No production deployment, consumer lock migration, PyPI upload or S3-S7 implementation is claimed.

coverage.unit: S1-S7 task status entries; not completed implementations

findings.text: Bounded native HTTP transport and compatible client fixtures are independently merged.
The final qualified wheel passed offline install, pip check and 90 tests on each Python 3.11 and 3.12.
The existing release preflight rejects the absent subactor-procache==0.1.0 PyPI entry.
A real worker remained alive 200 ms after SIGTERM and SIGKILL of its parent at the separate fault-source revision; owned processes were then terminated.
Resolve the dependency publication prerequisite, qualify consumer profiles and implement S3-S7 in their existing bounded tasks.

checks.name: Merged transport CI, Python 3.11/3.12/3.13
checks.reason: 1408 passed and 2 skipped on each interpreter.

checks.name: Offline installed final wheel, Python 3.11/3.12
checks.reason: 90 tests per interpreter plus pip check; installed module bytes match the downloaded qualified wheel.

checks.name: S7 parent-death reproduction
checks.reason: Fault reproduced for both signals; reproduction does not constitute a fix.

checks.name: S3-S7 implementations and consumer migration
checks.reason: These remain backlog/proposals; policy race and parallel consumer profile qualification are unexecuted.

limitations: Task status coverage is complete; requested implementations and PyPI publication are incomplete.
Private receipt digests are evidence bindings, not independent publication authority.
The S7 fault observation used an earlier identified revision; no final-source S7 fix is claimed.

next_actions.description: Resolve the verified dependency index prerequisite and use the existing protected release path.
next_actions.resume_when: The required procache version is independently published with verified publisher registration.

next_actions.description: Continue the bounded S3-S7 backlog and consumer profile qualification.
next_actions.resume_when: Existing task ownership, criteria and scope are admitted.
